theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (F : Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid k)) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) → (∀ u ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ F u) → (∀ u ∈ A, ‖F u‖ < ρ) → ∃ G : Euclid (k + 1) → Euclid P, (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K G) ∧ ∀ u ∈ A, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) = t • F u ∧ (fun a => fderiv ℝ G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))) (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) = (Fin.cons (F u) (t • fun b => fderiv ℝ F u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P)
